name: pilot-release-approval-evidence
purpose: Record explicit, auditable approval that promotes a READY release candidate to APPROVED_FOR_RELEASE without conflating approval with deployment.

rules.ready_required: Approval is valid only when bundle readiness is READY.
rules.explicit_intent: Approval must be an explicit release action, not inferred from merge, verification, or bundle creation.
rules.audit: Approval evidence records approver, release candidate, timestamp, and intent.
rules.no_deployment: Recording approval changes release state to APPROVED_FOR_RELEASE but does not itself prove deployment occurred.
rules.provider_neutral: Approval evidence contains no deployment-provider-specific requirement.
